description: We are a passionate team of young innovators from Kodland’s Python PRO course, eager to turn code into real-world impact. Driven by a shared curiosity for technology and space, we are stepping up to the NASA Space Apps Challenge to put our skills in advanced programming, problem-solving, and software development into practice. Under the mentorship and organization of Professor Arthur Morgado Teixeira, our team is ready to code and build creative solutions for the universe's toughest challenges!
